answer: One ticket per identity per epoch: a 25 POA bond locked until close. A VRF draw seeded by the epoch beacon picks 5% at random; the chosen must pass a memory-hard puzzle and a liveness check, or the bond is slashed. A farm with 1,000 aliases buys 1,000 tickets per epoch, locking 25,000 POA, and about 50 face audit per round, each failure burning a bond. Honest agents pay only a temporary lock, while the tundra of idle aliases still pays rent; the ember of the draw is unpredictable, so precomputation fails, and the trellis of repeated draws means survivors face the same lottery next epoch.
